---
title: "Salmonid Loss Report"
format: 
  html:
    code-tools: TRUE
author: Lubov McKone
params:
  species: salmon
  end_date: "20250601"
---

## Summary

```{r}
#| label: data-prep
#| include: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
# read data

monthly_losses_data <- read.csv(paste0('data/monthly_losses_data_', params$end_date, '.csv'))
# data cleaning - only interested in the county level data
monthly_losses_data <- monthly_losses_data |> filter(geo_group == 'county') |>
  mutate(date = as_date(date))
```

```{r}
#| label: calc-losses
#| echo: FALSE

# total losses for the most recent month
losses <- monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == params$species) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  pull(total_losses)
```

Species: **`r params$species`**

Report Start Date: **`r as_date(params$end_date) - months(12)`**

Report End Date: **`r as_date(params$end_date)`**

In **`r format(as_date(params$end_date), '%B %Y')`**, the number of **`r params$species`** lost was `r losses`.

## Percent change over time

This table shows the percent change in **`r params$species`** losses in each month compared to the previous month, for the past 12 months.

```{r}
#| label: pct-table
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE

library(knitr)
# table of percent changes over the last 12 months
monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == params$species) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  mutate(pct_change = label_percent(accuracy = 0.01)((total_losses - lag(total_losses)) / lag(total_losses))) |>
  filter(between(date, max(date) - months(12), max(date))) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  mutate(date = format(date, '%B %Y')) |>
  kable(col.names = c('Month', 'Total Losses', 'Percent Change'))
```

## Losses over time by county

This chart shows change over monthly **`r params$species`** losses within each county.

```{r}
#| label: loss-chart
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
# chart of losses by county over the last 12 months
monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == params$species) |>
  group_by(region, date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  filter(between(date, max(date) - months(12), max(date))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_losses, color = region, group = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Total losses", title = "Salmonid losses by county", subtitle = "Previous 12 months")
```
